title: 1957–58 National Hurling League

{{Short description|27th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1957–58 National Hurling League |image = |dates =13 October 1957 – 11 May 1958 |teams = 19 |team1 = Wexford |captain1 = [[Harry O'Connor (hurler)|Harry O'Connor]] |manager1 = |titles = 2nd |team2 = Limerick |captain2 = [[Dermot Kelly (hurler)|Dermot Kelly]] |manager2 = |previous = [[1956–57 National Hurling League|1956–57]] |next = [[1958–59 National Hurling League|1958–59]] }} The '''1957–58 National Hurling League''' was the 27th season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |image = |season=1957-58 |winners=[[Wexford GAA|Wexford]]
2nd National League title
Captain: [[Harry O'Connor (hurler)|Harry O'Connor]] |relegated= |continentalcup1= |continentalcup1 qualifiers= |continentalcup2= |continentalcup2 qualifiers= |league topscorer= |best goalkeeper= |biggest home win= |biggest away win= |highest scoring= |matches= |total goals= |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest winless= |longest losses= |highest attendance= |lowest attendance= |attendance= |average attendance= |prevseason=[[1956-57 National Hurling League|1956-57]] |nextseason=[[1958-59 National Hurling League|1958-59]] |updated=2 May 2017 }} [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[1956-57 National Hurling League|1956-57 season]]. [[Kerry GAA|Kerry]] and [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] entered Division 1 as the promoted team from the previous season. On 11 May 1958, [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] won the title following a 5-7 to 4-8 victory over Limerick in the final. It was their second league title overall and their first since [[1955-56 National Hurling League|1955-56]].{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National
